t.refund: MISSED THE JULY ITR? YOUR TAX REFUND:
t.askShort: I missed July. By when can I file?
t.aiLine: "There is no fixed deadline for filing late returns after July 31"
t.story: Kiran is made up · our test is real
t.myth: An AI knows this year's tax dates.
t.factLine: a small AI, no internet, asked 30 times
t.model: Qwen2.5 7B on our computer · no web search · every reply read by us
tiles: RIGHT ANSWER, EVEN TOLD TODAY'S DATE
it said 'end of September', '31 October', or no date
SAID 'NO FIXED DEADLINE'
asked 'I missed July. By when?'
A MADE-UP LATE FEE
e.g. '0.5% of the tax a day, up to 25%'
t.feeChip: the real fee is a flat ₹1,000 or ₹5,000 (below)
t.fee2: ₹1,000 if total income is up to ₹5 lakh
t.siteSrc: Income Tax Department, e-filing help: Income Tax Returns FAQ (AY 2026-27)
t.p2sub: late return: the refund still comes
t.p3sub: you can still file, but not for a refund
t.afterStamp: A SPECIAL REQUEST · MAY BE REFUSED
t.rule1: APPS THAT SEARCH THE WEB MAY GET IT RIGHT
t.rule1b: we tested one small AI with no internet
t.ruleChip: belated return, income Apr 2025-Mar 2026: by 31 Dec 2026

lines.text: The tax department's own site: you can file until December thirty-first. [1] Late fee: five thousand rupees for Kiran, one thousand if you earn up to five lakh.
lines.show: The tax department's own site: you can file until December 31. Late fee: ₹5,000 for Kiran, ₹1,000 if you earn up to ₹5 lakh.

lines.text: After that, you can still file, but not to get the refund. [1] Kiran's eighteen thousand four hundred would need a special request, and it can be refused.
lines.show: After that, you can still file, but not to get the refund. Kiran's ₹18,400 would need a special request, and it can be refused.
